text:
Companion animal travel is easiest when everyone follows the same desk workflow. This section covers how the Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk handles approvals, paperwork, and in-flight monitoring coordination.

For boarding, staff require the completed “FM-597” before any pet can be cleared for the skyport check-in line. Keep the form accessible during bag drop and identity matching, and confirm the pet’s cabin readiness with the cabin team so handoffs stay smooth between the desk and the aircraft cabin.

For incident reporting, notify the lead “Claim Adjudicator” right away, and document what you observed in plain language for follow-up review. When an animal shows distress, respond calmly, coordinate with the cabin team for immediate support, and preserve any relevant details so the incident record is coherent from first report to resolution.

Greet travelers with a warm professional tone, double-check travel constraints early, and coordinate any special handling notes with the cabin team before departure. If Samuel Svensson brings Coco to the desk, or if Nora Khan needs same-day routing help, keep communication clear, confirm the pet’s status on the internal travel log, and make sure the cabin team receives the latest updates before the aircraft departs.

If you run into confusion about approvals or escalation steps, contact the supervisor at the Companion Animal Travel Desk radio channel for immediate guidance.
